text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Smart Falcon—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wah, found a squishy and cute plushie☆
So adorable~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of her gaze was a claw machine.
Inside were plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by such cute plushies,
maybe Falco's Umadol power will level up too...♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think so too, Trainer?
—Right? Right!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right! Then Falco has a favor to ask☆
Could you... win a plushie for me?♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to worry!
Falco will cheer you on with all her might!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do your best~~!
Hip, hip, hooray~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've been dragged into this somehow,
but regardless...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
